audience: HR teams with company-authorized Talenta API access and scoped HMAC credentials

useCases.title: Review new employees and their departments
useCases.text: List employees joining during the requested period and review their employment details and departments.

useCases.title: Check attendance and leave
useCases.text: Review attendance for a selected day alongside time off requests for the relevant period.

useCases.title: Inspect a payroll report
useCases.text: Read the requested payroll report when company policy and the application scopes permit sharing it with your AI client. This does not calculate, approve or pay salaries.

useCases.title: Review recruitment progress
useCases.text: List open jobs and candidates, then inspect a selected application and the available hiring stages.
